headline: Deadlocked adds 331 functions and reaches 4.41% matched code
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 matched code rose from 4.03% to 4.41%, with 3,496 of 18,085 functions reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Five merged batches add 331 small game, core and level routines.
highlights: #26 through #30 bring the new implementations. PAL's final total is 3,470 of 18,113 functions.
Candidates with unresolved relocations, a wrong jump table or a wrong linked size are left out.
The full audit still reports 80 relocation mismatches across 43 functions and three unresolved cases, unchanged from main.
#32 through #35 propose further PAL work and remain unmerged.
